This magnitude of growth both in incidence and in the rate of suicides is quite significant in the back drop of compound growth of 2.1 per cent of population. The incidence of suicides increased by 76 per cent in the decade (1984- 1994) from 50571 to 89195. columns.name: - 1994 INCIDENCE & RATE OF SUICIDES IN STATES, UTs & CITIES: TABLE-7 presents the position of each State,UT and City in total suicidal deaths. it is noticed that West Bengal state which has 4th highest share (8.0%) in the population of the country accounted for the highest share in the incidence of suicidal deaths consecutively for 7 years. Continuing the earlier trend, in this year (1994) West Bengal reported the highest percentage of 13.9 % of total suicides that were recorded at All-India.
